_storage: bit blessings -> one bit in the bitfield at +0x36BC80 (g_flags 0xD9). armor/leggings are NOT bits: they write a LEVEL into the raval array at +0x36A654, indexed by the EQUIPPED PIECE's own item index (live-confirmed: Riveted Leather 0x12 -> slot 18, Riveted Boots 0x2A -> slot 42), which is why a bit sweep never sees them and why they are repeatable.
